about: Live Neural Junkie scenario benchmarks on local Ollama models. Each run switches all in-process agents to one model tag, then executes the same implement + chat scenarios from scenarios/implement/ and scenarios/chat/.

release.description: Release gate — benchmark winners only (~10–20 min).

quick.description: Smoke benchmark — 5 implement + 2 chat scenarios (~15–45 min per model; roster ≤9 GB footprint, e.g. Qwen 2.5 Coder 14B).

standard.description: Balanced gate — quick implement + regression chat tag filter.
